messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up — Blue Ridge Analytics just hit a production outage after their org was suspended by dunning. They claim they submitted a corrected PO (VAT-exempt, EU) and that their card was charged but declined due to 3DS failure. Customer is asking to be reinstated ASAP; says it's 100% blocking customers.

invoice-bot: Automated dunning notice sent to blue-ridge@bra.com for invoice 2026-6945 (amount EUR 18,450). Next step: suspending service in 48h unless payment confirmed.

maria-cs: Repro notes from the customer: they uploaded PO #BR-PO-7832 (PDF attached in their ticket) and then attempted to pay with a company card — the card issuer requested 3DS and the challenge failed. They sent us a vendor email saying they have VAT-exempt status in Belgium (VAT ID BE0123456789).

jake-billing: Thanks — I'm pulling the billing events now. Invoice 2026-6945 shows an ACH attempt? looks like payment method: card_visa_****1111 attempted at 2026-04-03T09:12Z and gateway returned DECLINED_3DS_REQUIRED -> gateway error 402_3DS_CHALLENGE_FAIL. No successful retries. PO BR-PO-7832 is attached to the account but not linked to the invoice.

sophie-collections: Do we have policy precedent for manual reinstates while payment is pending but a valid PO exists and customer claims VAT-exempt? We usually require either cleared payment or a signed PO + promise date.

olivia-legal: VAT-exemption docs need confirmation — we should validate BE VAT ID via VIES before accepting. If they are EU VAT-exempt (reverse charge), we can accept the PO but we still need to resolve payment instrument for past-due balance.

maria-cs: Customer insists they can sign a short payment commitment and will retry payment after updating their 3DS settings. They offered to provide a bank transfer (SEPA) — says will initiate today if we unblock.

tomas-payments: Quick ask for infra: can our billing system accept a manual hold/override so we don't auto-suspend while Collections works the payment path? If so, we can set a temporary grace for 24h and watch for SEPA.

jake-billing: We have an 'override_hold' flag on account objects. I can set it but need approvals from collections + legal for VAT cases. If collections approves, I'll flip the flag and mark invoice as 'awaiting-sepa'.

sophie-collections: Approve provisional hold for 24h pending SEPA initiation and VAT validation. Require clear commit from customer (email thread or signed promise). Also add requirement: customer must share SEPA tx reference within 6 hours of initiation.

maria-cs: I'll escalate to the customer now and request SEPA reference + VIES confirmation screenshot. Also mentioning 24h provisional hold and that failure to provide will reinstate suspension.

invoice-bot: Account hold applied by jake-billing for 24 hours on account: blue-ridge-analytics (note: manual hold — service not suspended).

jake-billing: Hold applied. I've also added a note to invoice 2026-6945: "awaiting SEPA tx + VAT verification". Logging here: ticket #CS-9321.

tomas-payments: On the payments side, if they want to retry card using 3DS, we can send a new payment attempt link that triggers the challenge. If they prefer SEPA, we'll need customer IBAN and remitter name. SEPA clears in 1-2 business days.

maria-cs: Customer replied: they initiated SEPA and provided remitter and IBAN, plus attached VIES lookup screenshot showing VAT ID valid. They've also uploaded a signed PO PDF with company stamp.

olivia-legal: VIES screenshot looks valid. Keep PO on file. Collections can accept SEPA path.

sophie-collections: Great — monitor for incoming settlement. If SEPA posts by EOD tomorrow, we clear and lift any flags. If it fails, we schedule suspension for 09:00 UTC next day and notify the customer.

jake-billing: Noted — I've set invoice status to awaiting_funds. Also added escalation to finance ledger to watch for SEPA settlement ID.

maria-cs: Customer extremely grateful. They asked if we can whitelist outgoing webhooks for their callback to avoid more payment gateway friction (they're using an in-house SCA relayer). I flagged to payments/eng to look into header signing.

tomas-payments: We can review their relayer approach, but whitelist isn't a thing at gateway level. Suggest they ensure SCA flow works through the standard redirect. For now, we have a provisional hold.

sophie-collections: Closing internal ask — collections will monitor. If settlement confirmed, collections will mark account current and update CS ticket. If anything changes, reopen this thread.

maria-cs: Thanks all. Follow-ups: (1) jake — remove the manual hold only after funds clear; (2) sophie — send final confirmation to customer; (3) olivia — file VAT validation evidence to the contract.

jake-billing: Will do.

sophie-collections: Will send confirmation once cleared. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: Marking resolved for now. Customer notified.
